wilyer-abreu.name: Wilyer Abreu
wilyer-abreu.top: Abreu is a lift-and-barrel hitter whose value comes from extra-base damage, not batting average: he makes contact at a league-average rate and turns a consistent fly-ball swing into above-average power. In 2026 his strikeout rate fell to league average and he took on an everyday role against lefties, and his underlying performance rose for a second straight season.

steven-kwan.name: Steven Kwan
steven-kwan.top: Kwan is an extreme contact-and-on-base hitter with almost no power. He rarely misses, rarely chases and repeats a line-drive launch better than anyone, but his exit velocity sits at the very bottom of the league. His value rests entirely on batting average and walks, which got him to a slightly below-average overall level in 2026 even as his damage kept shrinking.

cody-bellinger.name: Cody Bellinger
cody-bellinger.top: Bellinger is a contact-and-launch hitter who rarely strikes out and puts the ball in play at productive angles to his pull side. That makes him a high-average bat with below-average power, because his exit velocity doesn't let his lift turn into much damage.

sal-frelick.name: Sal Frelick
sal-frelick.top: Frelick is a bat-to-ball, ground-ball hitter who rarely swings and misses but rarely hits the ball hard. His value depends on contact and speed turning into batting average, and in 2026 that contact produced too little average or power to make him an above-average bat.
